title: Rust SCHC peer revocation leaves neighbor and Trickle state stale
description: rust/lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs revoke_schc_peer removes matching DODAG parents on DIO parse/version/link-evidence rejection but does not update/remove NeighborTable state or reset Trickle when rank, join, or preferred parent changes. A malformed/mismatched authenticated DIO from the preferred parent can unjoin/reparent while control-plane suppression remains stale. Route revocation through one invariant-preserving parent/neighbor transition that recomputes state and signals inconsistency, with preferred/nonpreferred/root and repeated-rejection tests.
notes:
Final correctness review: revoke_schc_peer unconditionally resets Trickle for every rejected authenticated DIO, even when the signer is not a parent/neighbor and routing state did not change. A pinned non-parent can force repeated Trickle resets. Reset only when parent/neighbor/rank/join/preferred state actually changes, matching the bead acceptance criteria.
Robustness review found revoke_schc_peer derives parent removals only from matching NeighborTable entries. If neighbor pruning/eviction already removed the entry, a DODAG parent with that signer IID survives. Remove parents directly by authenticated signer IID, then reset Trickle only if topology changed.
